lyrics.ti:
[[chorus]]
ኣነስ ብምግባረይ ድኹም ኮይነ’የ /2/
ሕዘንለይ ድንግል ናባኺ መጺኤ /2/
[[/chorus]]

እቲ ናይ ሓዊ ባሕሪ
ብዓይነይ ከይርእዮ
ንቅዱስ ሚካኤል
[[highlight]]ኣሕልፎ በልዮ /2/[[/highlight]]

ናይ ዳዊት መሰንቆ

ናይ ኤልያስ መና

ናይ ናሆም መድኃኒት
[[highlight]]ንዒ በደመና /2/[[/highlight]]

ክደኽመኒ ከሎ
ንስኺ’ኺ ሓይለይ
ናይ ልበይ መድኃኒት
[[highlight]]ረዳኢት ምርኩሰይ/2/[[/highlight]]

እነብዕ ኣለኹ
ኣብ ቅድሜኺ ኮይነ
እልምነኪ ድንግል
[[highlight]]በደለይ ኣሚነ /2/[[/highlight]]

ዘይውዳእ ምሕረት

ኣብ ወድኺ ኣሎ

ነቲ ዝኣምነኪ
[[highlight]]ሰላምኪ ሃብዮ /2/[[/highlight]]
lyrics.ti_ro:
[[chorus]]
ʾAnes bimgibarey dikhum koyne’ye /2/
Hizenley dingil nabakhi metsiʾe /2/
[[/chorus]]

ʾIti nay hawi bahri
Biʿayney keyriʾiyo
Niqdus Mikaʾel
[[highlight]]ʾAhlifo belyo /2/[[/highlight]]

Nay Dawit mesenqo

Nay ʾElyas mena

Nay nahom medhanit
[[highlight]]Niʿi bedemena /2/[[/highlight]]

Kidekhmeni kelo
Niskhi’khi hayley
Nay libey medhanit
[[highlight]]Redaʾit mirkusey/2/[[/highlight]]

ʾInebʿi ʾalekhu
ʾAb qidmekhi koyne
ʾIlmineki dingil
[[highlight]]Bedeley ʾamine /2/[[/highlight]]

Zeywidaʾi mihret

ʾAb wedkhi ʾalo

Neti ziʾamneki
[[highlight]]Selamki habyo /2/[[/highlight]]
